task_definition.description:
KCC-ζ: declare stdlib kinematic.ri first-class types (DrivingJoint marker trait + per-joint-kind structures). [RELAXED TWICE 2026-05-30 — full audit trail + rationale in details (esc-3845-77 + esc-3845-91). The original KCC-ζ scope assumed a SIR-α typed-joint substrate that PRD §7.1 explicitly rejects ("Value::Map representations remain"); both premise-dependent sub-goals are removed below.]

SCOPE (trimmed to the achievable deliverable): Add stdlib type declarations in a NEW crates/reify-compiler/stdlib/kinematic.ri registering `trait DrivingJoint {}` (marker trait) + per-joint-kind structures conforming via the `: DrivingJoint` clause (Prismatic/Revolute/Cylindrical/Planar/Spherical conform; Coupling/Fixed declared WITHOUT the clause). Also declare top-level Mechanism/Snapshot/BodyId/SweepDim structures. Conformance is nominal (declared at structure-def site — the only mechanism Reify's grammar supports; G3-confirmed against materials_fea.ri's `structure def X : Trait`).

USER-OBSERVABLE SIGNAL: nominal STRUCTURE-INSTANTIATION conformance compiles — the kinematic.ri declarations type-check (materials_fea.ri-style `structure def X : Trait`). NOT a runtime/compile type-error test.

EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE (both false-premised given joints stay Value::Map per PRD §7.1):
- NOT the bind-coupling compile error (type_error_on_bind_coupling) — bind/couple are bare eval_builtins with no compiler-visible signature → owned by task 4081 (function-call-arg trait conformance), where it re-enables against a real .ri DrivingJoint-bounded fn param.
- NOT retiring kinematic_query_result_type/KINEMATIC_FUNCTION_OVERRIDES (units.rs) or driving_joint_kind (sweep.rs) — they KEEP providing runtime range-dimension validation (prismatic→LENGTH/revolute→ANGLE) + compile-time result typing of bare eval_builtins (interferes/interferes_with/min_clearance) that SIR-α cannot replace while joints are Value::Map; retirement is contingent on a future joints→SIR-α-StructureInstance migration (latent PRD-§7.1-reversal question, no owner).

Consumer: KCC-θ (supersession), KCC-ι (integration gate). Crates touched: crates/reify-compiler/stdlib/kinematic.ri (NEW) only. Prereq: SIR-α task 3540 (done).
